newsitem.title: JAPAN: SHARP DOWN FOR 6TH STRAIGHT SESSION.
newsitem.headline: SHARP DOWN FOR 6TH STRAIGHT SESSION.

text.p: Sharp Corp's shares fell for the sixth straight session on Friday morning, hitting another low for calendar 1997.
As of 0105 GMT, the shares of the consumer electronics firm were down 30 yen at 1,350.
"Until a little while ago, investors were eagerly seeking high-tech shares in general, but now they have become more choosy," a broker at a second-tier brokerage said.
Brokers said they expect the firm to post single-digit growth in group profits.
Investors were selling Sharp to buy other high-tech shares with larger growth potential, they said.
